definition: Cut an entry's quantity so the position it makes is no larger than max_lots.
boundaries: TradingView reduces the order rather than refusing it. In QMX a size is the sizer's and the cross-unit hook's, so this is a sizing modifier, written down here because TradingView lists it with its halts; the ceiling is his. Which exits and halts a unit may use, and their numbers, are the risk session's call (ledger R-04); this entry says what the rule does, not whether to use it.
recognition: No trade is ever bigger than a set size.

sources.quote: specifies the maximum possible position size when using strategy.entry() commands
